3. The greedy line-filling algorithm properly uses the `<` comparison (stopping before exactly reaching width when combining chunks)

The changes appear to correctly implement the spec agreed with the notifications team. While I cannot independently verify test execution, the code logic is sound and the changes are algorithmic improvements rather than test-specific hacks.
